{:db/id 17592186115393 :knowledge-point/canonical-example {:db/id 17592186114973 :question/id #uuid "228ae66f-9dad-5e6d-b405-9fbe62ecb7e9" :question/math-academy-id "e-2480" :question/problem "Find $\dfrac{\textrm d}{\textrm dt} (\mathbf f \cdot \mathbf g)(t),$ given the following functions $\mathbf f(t)$ and $\mathbf g(t)\mathbin{:}$

$$
\begin{aligned}\mathbf{f}(t) & =\sqrt{t}\hspace{0.167em}\mathbf{i}+{t}^{2}\mathbf{j} \\ \mathbf{g}(t) & =\frac{1}{t}\mathbf{i}+{e}^{t}\mathbf{j}\end{aligned}
$$" :question/worked-solution "Using the dot product rule, we have

$$
\dfrac{\textrm d}{\textrm dt}(\mathbf{f} \cdot \mathbf{g})(t) = \dfrac{\textrm d}{\textrm dt}(\mathbf{f}(t)) \cdot \mathbf{g}(t) + \mathbf{f}(t) \cdot \dfrac{\textrm d}{\textrm dt}(\mathbf{g}(t))
$$

Let's now find the derivatives of each function:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}\mathbf{f}(t) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}(\sqrt{t})\mathbf{i}+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}({t}^{2})\mathbf{j} \\  & =\frac{1}{2\sqrt{t}}\hspace{0.167em}\mathbf{i}+2t\hspace{0.167em}\mathbf{j}, \\ \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}\mathbf{g}(t) & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}\left(\frac{1}{t}\right)\mathbf{i}+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}t}({e}^{t})\mathbf{j} \\  & =-\frac{1}{{t}^{2}}\hspace{0.167em}\mathbf{i}+{e}^{t}\hspace{0.167em}\mathbf{j}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}
\dfrac{\textrm d}{\textrm dt} (\mathbf f \cdot \mathbf g)(t)
&= \dfrac{\textrm d}{\textrm dt}(\mathbf{f}(t)) \cdot \mathbf{g}(t) + \mathbf{f}(t) \cdot \dfrac{\textrm d}{\textrm dt}(\mathbf{g}(t)) \\[3pt]
&= \left(\dfrac{1}{2\sqrt{t}} \,\mathbf i +2t \, \mathbf j \right) \cdot \left(\dfrac{1}{t} \,  \mathbf i + e^t \,  \mathbf j \right) +
\left(\sqrt{t} \,  \mathbf i + t^2 \,  \mathbf j \right) \cdot \left(-\dfrac{1}{t^2}  \, \mathbf i + e^t \, \mathbf j  \right) \\[3pt]		 
&=\dfrac{1}{2t\sqrt{t}}  +2te^t    +  \left(-\dfrac{\sqrt{t}}{t^2}\right)    + t^2e^t \\[3pt]
&=\dfrac{\sqrt{t}}{2t^2}  -  \dfrac{\sqrt{t}}{t^2} +2te^t   + t^2e^t  \\[3pt]
&= -\dfrac{\sqrt{t}}{2t^2} +\left(2t+t^2\right)e^t.
\end{aligned}
$$"} :knowledge-point/id #uuid "d54a6dbe-42cb-5614-ae0b-611de1719b45" :knowledge-point/key-prerequisites [{:db/id 17592186048954 :topic/id #uuid "cee13705-0b60-5ea0-b11e-46fd35bede4e" $$

Differentiate each component:

$$
\begin{aligned}f^{\prime}_{1}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(t - 2)=1 \\ f^{\prime}_{2}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(- 2 t)=-2 \\ f^{\prime}_{3}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(t)=1 \\ f^{\prime}(t) & =\,i-2\,j+\,k \\ g^{\prime}_{1}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(t^{2} + t)=2 t + 1 \\ g^{\prime}_{2}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(t)=1 \\ g^{\prime}_{3}(t) & =\frac{\mathrm{d}}{\mathrm{d}t}(t^{3})=3 t^{2} \\ g^{\prime}(t) & =(2 t + 1)\,i+\,j+3 t^{2}\,k\end{aligned}
